concepts.gloss_en: The act of raising up the fallen faith (which produces converts/gerim)

members.note: same core action-phrase in same Torah (lm2:5); the trailing clause 'ונחלש אמונתם' is an added consequence, not a different construct head — the named act is identical

notes: Both are the same act of 'raising the fallen faith' within lm2:5; the second is a longer sentence-fragment appending the consequence that their faith is weakened. Merged as likely, not obvious, because the second form carries extra predication.
